'''Crassus''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who was known for his avarice. He created the piece of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-imbued [[Armor/Legends|armor]] known as the [[Gauntlet of Crassus]], which rendered its wearer's grip unbreakable and allegedly increased the strength of the individual's [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] abilities.<ref name="FDCR" />

After his [[Death/Legends|death]], Crassus was [[Burial/Legends|buried]] in a [[Crassus's tomb|tomb]] in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]. Knowledge of the tomb's location was eventually lost to history, and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], long after Crassus's death, it was believed that the Gauntlet of Crassus had also been interred in its creator's final resting place.<ref name="FDCR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Crassus was introduced in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|core rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="FDCR" />
